results.title: Anthropic Claude Free Credits: up to $300 of free credits - 2026
results.description: Get $300 in free Anthropic Claude credits via LLM API. No markup, no subscription. Ideal for founders building and testing AI products.
results.snippet:
# Anthropic Claude Free Credits
New users with business email addresses can access free credits ranging from $50 to $300 for Google Gemini models via the LLM API platform. To claim credits, deposit between $50 and $300 to your LLM API account, and you'll receive 2x credits.

These credits are available to new users and can be used across key Claude models, including Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Opus. LLM API operates as a free gateway, meaning founders pay standard Anthropic rates with no additional platform fees or subscription requirements
